name: App Date
source:
Main character registers on the meeting web site by friend's advice. Will he be able to find his love and meet her in real world?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角聽從朋友建議，在交友網站上註冊。這個男孩能找到心儀的女孩，在現實生活中與她見面嗎？
